name: @sidleo3/mcp-wiki
description: MCP server for the llm-wiki knowledge base: OKF v0.2-conformant markdown bundle exposed over stdio. Registers the same 14 wiki_* tools as the DSH plugin (list/search/get/create/update/validate/lint/ingest/deprecate/rules/help/dirs/use/sync) and delivers the bundle + per-directory APPEND_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md rules through the MCP `instructions` field, so any MCP-capable agent (Claude Code / Cursor / Codex …) gets plugin-like behaviour. Fully local, self-contained (vendor-core embedded).
